craft_notes: Sthāyin: ānanda as address; vyabhicāri joy (harṣa) that all shines in You (C1 rasa block). Sanskrit-first: tvam eva…tvaṃ eva (YOU alone…You ALONE — eva hammered thrice, kept thrice); mahimnaḥ śaktyā (BY GLORY'S POWER — genitive force, kept); kartā…parameśvaraḥ (maker…supreme Lord — both offices named). Rows: 7 (vocative ‘O dense consciousness’ opens — direct current, anti-vighna), 9 (You-alone ×3 anaphora), 1 (‘supreme Lord’ closes — maker + Lord gathered). Close: ‘the supreme Lord’. Rupture: ‘And they flash’ (shining turns to flashing/making — stasis to power). Rejected: ‘You only’ — killed: eva is alone (exclusion), ‘only’ weakens to mere-ness; ‘by Your glorious power’ — killed: flattens the genitive (glory's-POWER acts). Read aloud: O-DENSE con-SCIOUS-ness — THERE-fore YOU a-LONE are su-PREME … AND-they-FLASH … YOU a-LONE are their MA-ker, the su-PREME-lord.

lines: O dense consciousness — therefore You alone are supreme; in You alone the worlds shine all at once.
And they flash by Your glory’s power — and You alone are their maker, the supreme Lord.
